content.title: Chapter 102 - UTILITIES — Sec. 102-137. - Private sewage disposal system.
content.summary:
The installation, alteration or repair of any private sewage disposal system or any
               part thereof will be in accordance with the Uniform Plumbing Code as adopted in section
               82-182.
(Code 1981, § 33-70; Ord. No. 2671, § 13, 10-16-1989)
